newsitem.title: USA: Loewen board said to meet Tuesday on bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen board said to meet Tuesday on bid.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc's board was to meet on Tuesday to discuss last week's unsolicited takeover bid from Service Corp Inc, a source close to Loewen said.
The meeting was to be held in Cincinnati, where Vancouver-based Loewen has corporate offices, the source said.
It was not known exactly when the board was to meet or when they might issue a recommendation on the bid.
A spokesman for Loewen declined comment on the board meeting.
Service Corp has offered to acquire Loewen in a stock transaction valued at $2.8 billion. The acquisition would link two leading operators of funeral homes and cemeteries.
Loewen has said it will review the Service Corp bid.
